_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Taking the Tower#000.src: You look like an adventurer in need of some work, pal. I have need of your services, but you'll need to be level {~} at least.
Taking the Tower#000.dst: Tu as tout l'air d'un aventurier en quête de travail, mon ami. J'ai besoin de tes services, mais il te faudra au moins le niveau {~}.
Taking the Tower#000.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#001.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been here to help!
Taking the Tower#001.dst: Tasim m'a tout raconté sur la force corrompue que vous avez éliminée. J'aurais aimé être là pour aider!
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: We did it! Let's get back to Lieutenant Van and tell him the news.
Taking the Tower#002.dst: On a réussi! Retournons voir le lieutenant Van pour lui annoncer la nouvelle.

Taking the Tower#003.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Item Upgrader!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: Oh, attends. On doit d'abord faire un détour. Suis-moi jusqu'à l'Améliorateur d'objets!
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to  Water damage!
Taking the Tower#004.dst: Apparemment, le grand méchant au sommet de la tour craint les dégâts de type  Eau!

Taking the Tower#005.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#005.dst: Tu peux appliquer différentes poudres élémentaires à tes armes, ce qui leur permet d'infliger des types de dégâts dont elles étaient incapables avant.
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: In this case, you can apply a  Water powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#006.dst: Dans ce cas, tu peux appliquer une poudre de type  Eau, pour que ton arme soit plus efficace contre les ennemis corrompus de la tour!
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and Hold the powder, then Right Click on your weapon. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#007.dst: ...Bref- tiens. Prends cette poudre élémentaire, tiens-la en main, puis fais un clic droit sur ton arme. Préviens-moi quand c'est fait!

Taking the Tower#009.src: You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.
Taking the Tower#009.dst: Tu vois cet Améliorateur d'objets? Il sert à faire passer les poudres à des rangs supérieurs.

Taking the Tower#010.src: It can also remove powders from your items, if you need to- don't worry, you'll get your powders back!
Taking the Tower#010.dst: Il peut aussi retirer les poudres de tes objets, si besoin- ne t'inquiète pas, tu récupères tes poudres!

Taking the Tower#011.src: ...Anyway, Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p}- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#011.dst: ...Bref, le lieutenant Van et les autres sont près de ce groupe de maisons de {p}- tu as dû les voir en arrivant.
Taking the Tower#011.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#012.src: It doesn't much matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#012.dst: Peu importe qui fait le travail, du moment qu'il est fait. Si vous voyez une occasion, foncez!
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#013.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?
Taking the Tower#013.dst: S'il faut battre en retraite, ou une fois les corrompus abattus, regroupez-vous ici! Compris?
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#014.src: Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!
Taking the Tower#014.dst: Hé, {u}, te voilà! Allez, on grimpe à cette tour!

Taking the Tower#015.src: They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#015.dst: C'est fait, mon lieutenant! {u} et moi avons atteint le sommet et vaincu le corrompu.
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#016.dst: Parlez à Aledar à la caserne de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#017.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: Oh, {u}! Salut! Content de vous revoir, Tasim et toi. Pas trop d'aventures sans moi, j'espère!
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#018.dst: Tasim est parti à la salle d'entraînement, si tu le cherchais. Il s'y met à fond, ce qui... est une bonne chose! On doit tous devenir plus forts pour défendre la province.
Taking the Tower#018.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#019.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#019.dst: ...Oh! Tant que tu es là- j'allais rejoindre l'escouade du lieutenant Van pour reprendre une tour tombée aux mains des corrompus. Tu devrais venir aussi!
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: Alors? Qu'en dis-tu? Envie d'un vrai baptême du feu? Ça ne devrait pas être long.
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.dst: Bien sûr, je viens avec toi.

Taking the Tower#022.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#022.dst: Parfait. Eh bien, pas de meilleur moment que maintenant! En route.
Taking the Tower#022.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#023.src: I've got something to do her
Taking the Tower#023.dst: J'ai quelque chose à faire ici

Taking the Tower#025.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#025.dst: Bon, je reste encore un moment ici. Si tu changes d'avis, dis-le-moi!
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#026.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#026.dst: Hé, te revoilà! Tu as changé d'avis? Tu veux participer à l'assaut d'une tour corrompue?
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#027.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#027.dst: Suivez Aledar jusqu'au Maître des poudres, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#028.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#028.dst: Bon, alors. On m'a parlé d'un truc sur la tour qu'on va attaquer, et on peut s'y préparer!
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#029.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#029.dst: Apparemment, le grand méchant au sommet de la tour craint les dégâts! Et donc, nous voilà chez le Maître des poudres.
Taking the Tower#029.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#030.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#030.dst: Je, euh... ne connais pas par coeur tout le discours sur les éléments. Si tu veux en savoir plus, va voir le capitaine Ragon à la caserne. Il a tout un cours là-dessus!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#031.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#031.dst: ...Bref- tiens. Prends cette poudre élémentaire et parle au Maître des poudres pour l'appliquer. Préviens-moi quand c'est fait!
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#032.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#032.dst: Appliquez une poudre d'Eau sur votre arme, puis prévenez Aledar en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#033.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: La poudre est sur ton arme? Bien, ça veut dire qu'on est prêts.
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#034.dst: Passe devant! Je te suis de près.
Taking the Tower#034.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#035.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#035.dst: Rejoignez l'escouade du lieutenant Van près de la Tour enragée, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#036.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: Ah, Aledar! Content de te voir. Qui est avec toi?
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: C'est {u}, mon lieutenant. Une recrue pour notre assaut, si vous le permettez.
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: Hm... Ma foi, pourquoi pas. Plus on est de fous, plus on rit, comme je dis toujours.
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: Si tout le monde est là, on peut commencer. Voici le plan! Il faudra repousser une partie des forces au pied de la tour pour que quelqu'un puisse grimper au sommet.
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#041.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#041.dst: Bien. Allez, soldats, reprenons cette tour!
Taking the Tower#041.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#042.dst: Allez, foncez vers la tour! Avec de la chance, on pourra la débarrasser des corrompus qui s'en sont emparés.
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#043.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#043.dst: Donnez l'assaut à la Tour enragée en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] et battez le monstre au sommet.

Taking the Tower#044.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#044.dst: Bien. C'est l'heure d'attaquer la tour! On va y arriver, {u}.
Taking the Tower#044.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#045.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taking the Tower#045.dst: Annoncez votre réussite au lieutenant Van, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taking the Tower#046.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#046.dst: On a réussi, on a tué le corrompu! Allez, retournons voir le lieutenant Van avec la nouvelle!
Taking the Tower#046.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#047.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#047.dst: On dirait que tout le monde est revenu. Alors? Les forces corrompues ont-elles été vaincues?
Taking the Tower#047.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#048.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#048.dst: Beau travail, soldats! Encore une belle victoire pour l'armée de {p}. Leur chef tué, nettoyer le reste ne devrait pas être bien difficile.
Taking the Tower#048.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#049.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#049.dst: J'informerai l'amiral de votre victoire du jour, soldats. Et- tenez, une paie pour votre travail.
Taking the Tower#049.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#050.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#050.dst: Vous deux avez un avenir prometteur. J'ai hâte de servir à nouveau à vos côtés!
Taking the Tower#050.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#052.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#052.dst: On s'occupera des derniers traînards, ne vous en faites pas. Merci pour votre travail aujourd'hui, soldat.
Taking the Tower#052.speaker: Lieutenant Van
